description: Central Province - Approinted Mr. Mahendra Karaputugala as the Chairman and Mr. Edirisinghe Gamini Samaratunga and Mr. W. G. Chaminda Thushara Kamalarathne as the members of Central Provincial Co-operative Employees Commission with effect from 01.06.2015
categorisation: This gazette names specific individuals (Mr. Mahendra Karaputugala, Mr. Edirisinghe Gamini Samaratunga, Mr. Wathuwala Gedara Chaminda Thushara Kamalarathne) and appoints them to a government commission (Central Provincial Co-operative Employees Commission). It also details the extensive portfolio responsibilities of the appointing authority (Chief Minister Sarath Ekanayaka), listing multiple subject areas under his ministry (Finance and Planning, Law and Order, Local Government, etc.). This combination of named individuals and detailed portfolio responsibilities makes it a Hybrid gazette (Type 3).
